Messages.Author: wolflord
Messages.Body:
Hi,
Small question on an issue I encountered on saturday in Barcelona.
I thought it was misplayed, called a judge (don't remember which one
it was, definitely not Damnans )and he said it was correct after all.
I feel rather ..uncomfortable with the ruling, so I thought I'd check:

Situation:
Player A (my grandprey) controlls Fleurdumal (Prince of Miami) with 1
blood, tapped.
I (his grandpredator) bleed my prey (and after a blocking attempt and
adding 3 stealth), deflected to player A
Player A plays: Wake with evening's freshness + Second Tradition, both
on Fleurdumal.
He untaps his vampire.(and afterwards tries to block, in which he
fails, due to +3 stealth added by me)

IMHO, I would say that either he plays WWEF+2ND, does not pay the one
blood, but does not untap; or he plays both cards, pays the 1 blood,
and untaps.

It was ruled that he can play WWEF, therefore can play the 2nd as if
untapped, and thus does not have to pay the 1 blood in order to
untap..

Can you clarify this for me?
Thanks in advance,
Jo

Messages.Author: salem
Messages.Body:
On 23 Oct 2003 06:32:41 -0700, jo.her...@sca.com (wolflord)
scrawled:



card text to the rescue?

Second Tradition: Domain [Jyhad, V:TES, CE]
Cardtype: Reaction
Requires a ready prince or justicar.
+2 intercept. Also usable by a tapped prince or justicar, even if
intercept is not yet needed, to burn a blood to untap and attempt to
block with +2 intercept.

If played as if untapped, all you get is +2 intercept.
If played as tapped, you must burn a blood _to_ untap etc.

You definately can't get a free untap out of it by combining with
WWEF. You can get the free intercept though (although you'll still be
tapped).

Correct. Second Tradition doesn't untap the vampire unless he burns
a blood. Playing Wake will allow playing Second Tradition for no
cost to gain +2 intercept, but gaining +2 intercept won't untap
the prince.
